title: Clover Village Road Completion Art Task
summary: The Earthen Vine Path autotile kit (CloverVillage road_1-13) is missing 5 of the 13 classic autotile roles. Recovery investigation (design/assets/road-kit-recovery.json) proved the full 26-tile VoidDesert kit is a different palette/vegetation family and that edge-east exists in no pack — so no catalog work or archive searching can complete this set. The correct fix is 5 new derived 64x64 tiles made in the Clover visual family, using VoidDesert tiles as topology reference only. See design/assets/asset-reviews.json -> reviews['CloverVillage/road_earthen_vine_path'].artTask for the machine-readable copy of this spec.
doNot: Do not copy VoidDesert tiles into CloverVillage — palette/vegetation does not match (desert-gold rgb(176,133,84), 0% green grass vs Clover warm rgb(189,131,101), 3.6% green grass).
Do not overwrite or rename the original CloverVillage road_1-13 assets.
Do not derive edge-east by pure horizontal mirror of edge-west and stop there — redo the vine/vegetation detail so it does not look mechanically mirrored.

provenance.policy: Every Paws & Parcels-original or derived asset must carry a provenance record distinguishing Source Asset (from the purchased/original pack) from Derived Asset (created for Paws & Parcels from licensed source). Track this from day one — the project is intended to be commercial.

acceptance: All 5 tiles are 64x64 PNGs in the Clover Earthen Vine Path palette (warm path + green grass).
Each tile matches its role's edge signature: measured open edges agree with the role (verified by the validator: Asset Catalog/analyze-road-autotile.mjs).
Placing the 13 existing + 5 new tiles in the draft test map renders with ZERO missing-role cells.
Edge-east does not look like a mechanical mirror of edge-west.
Variant system ready: existing duplicate roles (edge-n A/B, outer-se A/B, outer-sw A/B, outer-nw A/B) remain available for deterministic seed-based variety.
variantNote: The pixel comparison proved road_7/8, road_1/13, road_3/12, road_9/10 are true variants (46.9-87.7% pixels differ) — do not delete them. Repeated identical tiles make tile-based environments look artificial. The runtime road system should eventually support EDGE_N { variant A, variant B } etc., chosen deterministically from map coordinate/seed — visual variety without affecting collision or topology.
